issues.summary: A cargo damage case requires a surveyor report and a formal claim to be submitted to Orient Container Line by 10 July 2026.
A detention dispute is open with the Hanseatic D&D desk over charges for two terminal-closure days.
S-021 required a manifest correction, and Pacific Star's written confirmation of it still has to be filed in the S-021 document register.

decisions.summary: Daniel Cho takes over all open Daehan Precision and Seoul Medica import files from 1 July because Jiwoo Han leaves on 30 June.

tasks.summary: Jiwoo Han to prepare a written handover for Daniel Cho covering open tasks, owners, due dates and key carrier/broker contacts.
Daniel Cho to go through the files with Jiwoo Han before she leaves on 30 June.
Daniel Cho to collect the surveyor report and submit a formal claim to Orient Container Line.
Daniel Cho to follow up the Hanseatic D&D desk on the detention dispute for the two terminal-closure days.
Daniel Cho to obtain the signed POD for S-024 and hand the cost sheet to Accounting.
Daniel Cho to send the Arrival Notice and request documents for S-025 (ETA 29 June), which has not yet been sent.
Grace Yoon to hold the Q2 vendor review and discuss the recorded non-conformance with Harbor Gate Customs Brokerage.
Daniel Cho to update the SOP-03 free-time table for Pacific Star's new 5-day reefer free time from July.

deadlines.what: Submit the formal claim with the surveyor report to Orient Container Line.
Follow up with the Hanseatic D&D desk on the detention dispute.
Issue the debit note to Rapid Haul Logistics for 4 days of detention.
Obtain the signed POD for S-024 and hand the cost sheet to Accounting.
Send the Arrival Notice and request documents for S-025.
Complete the Q2 vendor review covering the Harbor Gate non-conformance.
Update the SOP-03 free-time table for Pacific Star's reefer free time.
File Pacific Star's written manifest-correction confirmation in the S-021 document register.
